name: vcsl_keys
character: VCSL Keys: the keyboard instruments of the Versilian Community Sample Library

all.what: the library as its author publishes it
all.manual_note: Open the page, download the SFZ instrument, then run: sfz_libs.py install-local vcsl_keys <downloaded.zip> --project <dir>. Then name it in an instrument preset: "sfz": {"library": "vcsl_keys", "patch": "<path/to/patch>"}.
